topic: Missing and misplaced numbers in a counting sequence

problems.note: number track 8-13 with the box for 11 empty

traps.desc: copied the number just before the empty box instead of counting on one more

problems.note: number track 45-50 with boxes for 47 and 49 empty

traps.desc: wrote 21, the number Mia said next, instead of the number she skipped

problems.desc: Student says or writes what Mia should remember: count every number in order without skipping - after 19 comes 20, then 21. Accept any wording that names the skipped number or the do-not-skip idea.

traps.desc: went back to the start of the tens after 39 instead of starting the forties

problems.desc: Student tells what went wrong in Leo's count: after a number ending in 9 a new tens group starts, so after 39 comes 40, not 30. Accept any wording that says the forties start after 39.

problems.note: hundred-chart row 91-100: boxes for 93 and 98 empty, 69 printed where 96 belongs

traps.desc: kept the printed card: wrote the digits of 96 in reversed order as 69

problems.desc: Student tells why 69 cannot come between 95 and 97: counting from 95 the next number is 96, and 69 belongs much earlier in the count (it is less than 95). Accept either the counting-on reason or the size reason.
